metadata.purpose: Eval/edge-case dataset for the founder's 2026-09-22 long-lyric-line complaint (a single line wrapping to 4+ visual lines and filling the player window). Used to measure CURRENT LyricsView.makeDisplayLyricLines / LyricDisplaySegmenter behavior before any redesign.

measurementRecipe.engine: NSLayoutManager (matches NativeLyricsTextMeasurement.metrics, the renderer's own measurement path)
measurementRecipe.note: MusicMiniPlayerApp.swift: windowSize=NSSize(250,316) is only the FIRST-LAUNCH size; snappableWindow.minSize=NSSize(180,228) is the real floor the aspect-locked window can be resized to. A histogram of this user's disk cache at width=250 found only 21 lines (all Latin) crossing the >=3-visual-line bar; at width=180 it found 135. The eval harness measures BOTH widths per line.

metadata.sourceNote: Real lines were harvested from the LIVE on-disk lyrics cache at ~/Library/Application Support/nanoPod/lyrics_cache.json (LyricsDiskCache.defaultURL()). Title/artist are NOT recoverable: LyricsDiskCache.cacheKeys() hashes them with SHA256 before the key ever touches disk, so the cache entry itself carries no title/artist field -- only album/duration/source, which we use as the identity proxy in `song`. The live cache is also NOT a stable snapshot: it shrank from 149 cached songs to 9 during this session (background TTL/max-entry-count pruning while the app was presumably running), so this dataset's 'real' pool reflects whatever the cache held at capture time, not the founder's full listening history. A few additional real lines (Korean, and the word-level ground-truth subset) were pulled from already-repo-checked-in real fixtures (Tests/Fixtures/netease_qicheng_wordlevel.json, netease_newjeans_howsweet_3328905844.json) because the live snapshot had zero word-level and zero Korean lines at capture time.

lines.text: 夜色渐渐笼罩着整座城市每一盏灯都藏着一个没有说完的故事我们沿着河边慢慢地走谁也没有先开口夜色渐渐笼罩着整座城市每一盏灯都
lines.translation: The night slowly wraps around the whole city and every lamp is hiding a story that was never finished as we walk slowly along the river neither of us wants to speak first
lines.note: 60 CJK characters, no spaces/punctuation anywhere -- stresses the segmenter's punctuation-boundary heuristics (no boundary exists at all) and, being word-level, is NEVER split by the current code.

lines.text: Antidisestablishmentarianismsupercalifragilisticexpialidocioussesquipedalianism
lines.note: A single unbreakable token longer than the per-line unit budget; the hard-wrap fallback must fragment it mid-word (there is no other option), which is the one case a whitespace/punctuation-based segmenter cannot avoid breaking mid-word.

lines.text: (ooh ooh ooh child things are gonna get brighter ooh ooh ooh child things'll get so much better wait and see)
lines.translation: (哦 哦 哦 宝贝 一切都会变得更好 哦 哦 哦 宝贝 一切都会好起来的 等着瞧吧)
lines.note: A whole-line backing-vocal parenthetical; splitting it loses the enclosing parens' 'this is one aside' signal unless a designed split keeps the parens balanced per piece.

lines.text: I I I I want want want you you you now now now now now yeah yeah yeah go go go go
lines.note: Many one-syllable repeated words with no punctuation -- exercises the orphan-avoidance / balanced-split word-bucket logic (LyricDisplaySegmenter.balancedSplitIndices).

lines.text: Wait, — no, stop! Really?! Yes, yes, yes... stop, wait, no! Please, just, stop, now! OK? OK. Fine, fine, fine.
lines.note: Punctuation on almost every word -- the strong/weak boundary tables fire constantly; checks the segmenter doesn't produce many tiny orphan pieces.

lines.text: 这一句歌词特别长但是它在这首歌里只被唱了很短很短的一瞬间几乎一晃就过去了
lines.note: 38 CJK characters compressed into a 0.3s window -- triggers shouldKeepDisplayLineUnsplit's per-piece minimum-duration guard (1.65s), which currently forces this line to stay UNSPLIT despite being very long.

lines.text: Yeah
lines.translation: 这一句翻译长得离谱因为原文里那一个短短的语气词背后其实藏着这首歌整段主歌想表达的全部情绪和转折
lines.note: balancedSegments(count=1) never triggers (the original isn't split), so this long translation renders as ONE unbroken translation row under a 4-character original -- an orphan-pairing edge case distinct from the split-line problem.

lines.text: I keep running through the midnight looking for a reason why every little thing keeps falling apart around me
lines.note: The long original gets split into several pieces; balancedSegments(for: '是的', count>1) has almost nothing to divide, so most split pieces end up with an EMPTY translation underneath them.

lines.text: 2024年6月15日🎉🎊我们相识1000天了💕💕💕生日快乐🥳🎂🍰愿你永远开心happy 21st birthday to you my love
lines.note: Emoji are outside CharacterSet.punctuationCharacters/whitespacesAndNewlines and not CJK/kana/hangul/thai -- displayUnits() falls through to the ASCII/other branches; check they don't get sliced apart from an adjacent digit run.

lines.text: أنا أحبك أكثر من أي شيء في هذا العالم كله ولن أتوقف أبداً عن حبك يا حياتي وروحي وقلبي الذي لا يهدأ
lines.note: RTL script -- displayUnits() treats Arabic as generic non-ASCII (0.85/char); a split must not reverse visual reading order or place a break inside a word given bidi reordering at render time.

lines.text: 사랑한다는 말로는 부족해 너를 향한 이 마음을 다 표현할 수 없어 그래도 매일매일 너에게 말해주고 싶어
lines.translation: Saying I love you isn't enough. I can't fully express this feeling toward you. But I still want to tell you every single day.
lines.note: Synthetic -- the real disk-cache snapshot and in-repo fixtures had no Korean line long enough to cross the >=3-visual-line bar (see research note); this fills the hangul stratum for the wrap-behavior metrics.
